skill.summary: Create, manage, sync, and share minimalist notes with tags, search, and reminders across multiple devices using simple commands.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the n minimalist note-taking skill.

- Create, manage, and sync notes across devices  
- Organize notes using tags or categories  
- Search notes by keywords  
- Share notes with other users  
- Set reminders for important notes  
- Seamless installation with no configuration required
